newsitem.title: USA: Mass. Senate set to take up $685.3 mln court bond.
newsitem.headline: Mass. Senate set to take up $685.3 mln court bond.

text.p: The Massachusetts Senate is set to act Thursday on a $685.3 million bond issue to repair and build the state's aging courthouses.

The measure coming out of the Senate Ways and Means committee is "almost identical" to a measure the full body passed during last year's legislative session and authorizes the same amount of spending as the version that cleared the state House last week, the committee's chairman Stanley Rosenberg, D-Amherst, told State House News Service.
The bill authorizes new facilites for Falmouth, Pittsfield, New Bedford, Belchertown, Dedham, Worcester and for Middlesex and Plymouth counties.

Rosenberg said the projects, along with others to repair or expand existing facilities, will make use of "state-of-the-art telecommunications and air quality technology in order to prepare for the future."
